Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; reviewed period printings; issue #734.

Cards.Name: Ready the Defenses
Cards.Text: Open: Choose your performing Personality and target a province: While at the province's battlefields, other players' Personalities and Followers have -1F and, if your performer is a Tactician, your Personalities and Followers have +1F.

Cards.Name: Unseemly Alliance
Cards.Text: Political Open: Bow your target unbowed Courtier. All Personalities have -1F for each Clan Alignment in their army (this turn).
